comments.value: Would be MUCH, MUCH better if we will be able to see fallbacks if you turn off someone's avatar, and not those annoying robots. And impostors are for LOD if someone is really far, and if it's above your security settings.
More importantloy, bring back the option to select Fallback Avatars in the menu--the function is available only on VRChat.com.  Please bring back this feature in-game menu.

I've made a couple posts about this already on other sites, but in short I agree they should stay.

This was also an... unusual first step to their removal with unusual timing since the imposter system still isn't quite done.

Please keep fallbacks around and easily manageable.
I like my fallback over pixelated imposter, and needs to be an option.

@{65972cf7315e3ba935f42f4c|full_name} That's kinda what prompted this post

The reason they removed the in-game option is cause they want to fully remove fallbacks in the future and just use Impostors

Related: https://feedback.vrchat.com/feature-requests/p/1643-fallback-avatars-linked-to-an-avatar-as-an-alternative-to-current-user-sele

I feel like that suggestion reflects a better solution than Impostors or Fallbacks alone; for a specific avatar, creators should be able to set (or upload) another avatar as a fallback for a specific avatar. For avatars that don't have these fallbacks set, impostors would be used instead; and if there is no impostor for some reason, I imagine a gray robot of some kind would be used (maybe with the fallback feather on it).

I and at least one other person have started noticing perf-blocked robots instead of fallbacks. There are still far too many avatars that don't have impostors, anecdotally half of the avatars I've seen since the robots have started showing up are those robots.

details:
I understand there are advantages to Impostors

but they are not inherently better

Fallbacks can have physics, facial expressions, visemes, hand gestures, toggles, etc

Please don't remove fallbacks
title: Fallbacks should stay
